_meta._docs: Program-block templates organised by MOVEMENT PATTERN (not specific exercises). MILO uses these as the structural scaffold when generating a program: it picks one (or you pick one), then fills in actual exercises based on the athlete's coaching principles + considerations. Mobility prep (ankle / hip / t-spine) is added automatically on top of every session — it does NOT need to be in the template.

_blockFields._docs: Reference: every block in a template can carry these optional fields. pattern is required.
_blockFields.reps: number, time ('30 seconds'), distance ('20m'), or range
_blockFields.loaded: true if external resistance, false if bodyweight / mobility / cardio

basic-training-ab.name: Basic 1
basic-training-ab.description: Foundational A/B split. Day A = horizontal push/pull + hip mobility. Day B = vertical push/pull + t-spine mobility. Ankle mobility caps every session.
basic-training-ab.cyclingNote: Run A then B (alternate). At 3x/week the 3rd session repeats A. At 4x/week run two full A-B cycles.

blocks.note: Power slot — coach picks (jumps / KB swing / med ball)
Combination slot — total-body multi-joint (e.g. KB clean+press, thruster, complex)

basic-training-ab.notes: Movement balance: Day A = horizontal push & pull, Day B = vertical push & pull. Mobility distribution across the cycle: A covers hip + ankle, B covers t-spine + ankle. All 3 mobility categories + both push/pull planes covered across each A-B cycle.

strength-builder-ab.name: Basic 2
strength-builder-ab.description: Volume bump over Basic Training. 2-4 sets x 10 reps. A includes a Combination slot (total-body multi-joint). B includes a Power slot. Lunge + Hinge in A, Single-leg stance + Squat in B = full lower-body coverage across the cycle.
strength-builder-ab.cyclingNote: Run A then B. At 3x/week the third session repeats A. At 4x/week run two full A-B cycles.

blocks.note: Combination slot — KB clean+press / thruster / complex
Power slot — jumps / KB swing / med ball

strength-builder-ab.notes: Strength + power balance: A drills Lunge + Hinge with horizontal push/pull. B drills Single-leg + Squat with vertical push/pull. Mobility cycle: A = hip + ankle, B = t-spine + ankle. Across each A-B cycle: every lower pattern, all H+V planes, all 3 mobility categories.

triplet-density-ab.name: Basic 3
triplet-density-ab.description: Density progression with triplet supersets (3 exercises back-to-back). 2-3 x 12. Shorter conditioning work:rest ratio (30s/30s). Triplet on the first set, pair on the second.
triplet-density-ab.cyclingNote: Triplet (1a-1b-1c) all back-to-back, rest, repeat. Then mobility, then pair (2a-2b). Conditioning, then ankle mobility.
triplet-density-ab.notes: Triplet structure 1a-1b-1c forces movement density. Conditioning ratio tightens to 1:1 (30s/30s) — more glycolytic stress. Power slot on both A and B (different from Strength Builder). Use this block when athlete has solid base + can handle higher exposure.

metabolic-strength-ab.name: Basic 4
metabolic-strength-ab.description: Metabolic finisher replaces intervals. Pick 3 strength exercises + 1 locomotion, run each for 15-20 seconds (no rep counting). Higher volume strength block (3-4 sets) up top. Can be supercharged into a giant set (1a-1b-2a-2b consecutive, no rest).
metabolic-strength-ab.cyclingNote: Strength pairs 1a/1b and 2a/2b run normally. Metabolic 3a-3d done back-to-back, no rest between exercises (Alwyn Cosgrove giant-set option: 1a/1b/2a/2b combined into one giant set if you want to supercharge).

blocks.note: Sled drag / bear crawl / farmer walk / sprint

metabolic-strength-ab.notes: Metabolic block replaces intervals — pick 4 movements (3 strength + 1 locomotion) you can hold for 15-20 sec without form breakdown. For body weight: elevated push-ups, BW squats. SUPERCHARGE: combine 1a/1b/2a/2b into one giant set, 90s rest, repeat (Alwyn Cosgrove method). For locomotion: sled drag, bear crawl, farmer walk, lateral shuffle, sprint, ski erg — depends on equipment/setting.

hypertrophy-1-ab.name: Hypertrophy 1
hypertrophy-1-ab.description: Lightest of the hypertrophy series. Daily undulating periodization (DUP): three rep schemes rotate across the days of a week — each session uses a different one. Scheme 1 = 4×6 (strength bias), Scheme 2 = 2×20 (endurance/lactate buffer), Scheme 3 = 3×12 (classic hypertrophy). Exercise template (A/B) rotates separately. Replaces conditioning intervals with a complex finisher (3-4 sets × 8 reps per movement).
hypertrophy-1-ab.cyclingNote: Each session in the week uses a different scheme from undulating.dailyRotation (Day 1 → scheme 1, Day 2 → scheme 2, Day 3 → scheme 3). Exercise template (A/B) alternates separately: at 3x/week the flow is A→B→A; at 4x/week run two full A-B cycles. Same exercises every week — schemes don't change across weeks, they change across DAYS within a week.

undulating._docs: Daily undulating periodization (DUP). Each session in the week uses a different sets×reps scheme. Schemes rotate across day-of-week, NOT across week-of-block. Apply scheme N to the Nth session of the week. At <3 sessions/week, drop the last scheme(s). At >3, repeat from scheme 1.

hypertrophy-1-ab.notes: Daily Undulating Periodization (DUP): the three rep schemes rotate ACROSS DAYS within a single week — not across weeks of the block. Same exercises every week; sets×reps change day-to-day. Lightest of the hypertrophy series — 4×6 is the strongest scheme here. Movement balance: A horizontal push/pull, B vertical push/pull. Mobility cycle: A hip+ankle, B t-spine+ankle. Complex finisher replaces intervals.

hypertrophy-2-ab.name: Hypertrophy 2
hypertrophy-2-ab.description: Middle of the hypertrophy series. Daily undulating periodization: each session in the week uses a different scheme — 4×5 (strength), 2×15 (endurance), 3×10 (hypertrophy). Loads sit between Hypertrophy 1 (4×6) and Hypertrophy 3 (4×4). Complex finisher 4-5 × 6.
hypertrophy-2-ab.cyclingNote: Each session in the week uses a different scheme from undulating.dailyRotation (Day 1 → scheme 1, Day 2 → scheme 2, Day 3 → scheme 3). Exercise template (A/B) alternates separately: at 3x/week run A→B→A; at 4x/week run two full A-B cycles.

hypertrophy-2-ab.notes: Middle template in the hypertrophy series. DUP rotates 4×5 / 2×15 / 3×10 across the days of each week. 4×5 is the strongest scheme — sits between Hypertrophy 1's 4×6 and Hypertrophy 3's 4×4. Use this for athletes who want pure hypertrophy stimulus without the endurance bias (H1) or near-maximal load (H3).

hypertrophy-3-ab.name: Hypertrophy 3
hypertrophy-3-ab.description: Heaviest of the hypertrophy series. Daily undulating periodization: each session in the week uses a different scheme — 4×4 (near-maximal strength), 2×12 (endurance buffer), 3×8 (classic hypertrophy). Complex finisher tightens to 4-5 × 5 (heaviest load, fewest reps). For athletes who've already cycled through Hypertrophy 1 + 2 or have a strong base.
hypertrophy-3-ab.cyclingNote: Each session in the week uses a different scheme from undulating.dailyRotation (Day 1 → scheme 1, Day 2 → scheme 2, Day 3 → scheme 3). Exercise template (A/B) alternates separately: at 3x/week run A→B→A; at 4x/week run two full A-B cycles.

hypertrophy-3-ab.notes: Strength-biased hypertrophy — heaviest of the 3 templates. DUP rotates 4×4 / 2×12 / 3×8 across the days of each week. 4×4 is near-maximal; 3×8 is classic hypertrophy; 2×12 is the lighter endurance buffer. Complex finisher load goes UP (5 reps = more weight on the bar). Use with athletes who have a strong base and can recover from heavy days.

strength-hypertrophy-4day.name: Strength + Hypertrophy I
strength-hypertrophy-4day.description: Advanced 4-day split. Each session has 3 zones: (1) Max Strength & Power — one main lift, 5 sets of 3-5 reps. (2) Muscle Hypertrophy — 4 accessory movements, 3-4 × 8-12 paired. (3) Free Zone — pick 2 exercises, 8-10 sets AMRAP inside a 5-minute window. Days alternate horizontal (A,C) and vertical (B,D) push/pull.
strength-hypertrophy-4day.cyclingNote: Run A → B → C → D each week. 4 sessions/week is the only frequency for this template (high volume + recovery demand).

strength-hypertrophy-4day.notes: 4-day high-volume block. Each session has a clear hierarchy: 1 heavy main lift (5×3-5 RPE 8) → 4 accessories paired (3-4 × 8-12) → Free Zone AMRAP (2 exercises alternated for 8-10 sets inside a 5-min window). Day pairing: A+B lower/upper horizontal+vertical primary, C+D mirror it with different patterns. Movement balance across the week: hinge, squat, vertical push, vertical pull each get one max-strength day. Mobility cycle: A+C hip+ankle, B+D t-spine+ankle. Only for athletes with strong base + 4 training days available. Watch fatigue going into week 3-4.

strength-endurance-ab.name: Strength + Endurance
strength-endurance-ab.description: Strength + muscular-endurance blend. A/B split, 6 weeks. Each session: one heavy paired strength block (2-3 × 6), a four-movement endurance quartet (2 × 15 across lunge/pull/single-leg/push), then a Free Zone AMRAP. Day A = horizontal push/pull + hip mobility. Day B = vertical push/pull + t-spine mobility.
strength-endurance-ab.cyclingNote: Run A then B (alternate). At 3x/week the 3rd session repeats A. Same exercises every week; load progresses week to week.

blocks.note: Free Zone — pick 2 exercises, alternate, as many sets as possible in 5 min
Free Zone — pick 2 exercises, alternate, AMRAP in 5 min

strength-endurance-ab.notes: Strength + endurance hybrid. ONE heavy pair (2-3 × 6 strength) followed by a FOUR-movement quartet at 2 × 15 (endurance). Quartet runs 2a-2b-2c-2d as a giant superset (or sequential pairs). Total volume per session is higher than Basic 4 because of the quartet, but loads stay manageable. Movement balance: Day A horizontal, Day B vertical. Mobility cycle: A hip+ankle, B t-spine+ankle. Free Zone closes every session.

strength-hypertrophy-2-4day.name: Strength + Hypertrophy II
strength-hypertrophy-2-4day.description: Higher-volume 4-day split. Each session has 3 zones: (1) Max Strength & Power — one main lift, 5 sets where the last set is a back-off burnout (5,5,5,5,8). (2) Muscle Hypertrophy — 2 paired blocks (1a/1b at 2-3 × 8 and 2a/2b at 3 × 8 / 12). (3) Free Zone AMRAP. Days alternate horizontal (A, C) and vertical (B, D) push/pull. Workout B's main is a heavier 3 × 3-6 vertical pull.
strength-hypertrophy-2-4day.cyclingNote: Run A → B → C → D each week. Main lift on A/C/D is 5 sets: sets 1-4 at heavy 5 reps, set 5 is a back-off burnout at 8 reps (rest-pause if needed). Workout B's main is a heavier 3 × 3-6 (lower volume, higher intensity pull day).

strength-hypertrophy-2-4day.notes: Higher-volume than Strength + Hypertrophy I — main lift is 5 sets with a back-off burnout (5,5,5,5,8) instead of 5×3-5 straight sets. Hypertrophy zone has TWO pairs (1a/1b + 2a/2b) instead of one. Workout B is intentionally different (3×3-6 pull, lighter overall) to give the upper-pull pattern a heavy day. Day pairing: A+C lower with horizontal accessories, B+D upper with vertical accessories. Mobility cycle: A+C hip+ankle, B+D t-spine+ankle.

strength-wave-4day.name: Strength Wave
strength-wave-4day.description: Peaking block with wave-loaded main lifts. Each main lift is 6 sets (two waves of three). Across 3 weeks the waves get heavier and reps drop: Week 1 = 7-5-3 / 7-5-3, Week 2 = 6-4-2 / 6-4-2, Week 3 = 5-3-1 / 5-3-1. Goal: hit a true 1RM by the final set of week 3. Workout D's main is a 3 × 5-10 pull (lighter to balance volume).
strength-wave-4day.cyclingNote: Run A → B → C → D each week. Main lift = 6 sets in two waves of 3. The Wave changes EACH WEEK (not each day): W1 = 7-5-3 / 7-5-3, W2 = 6-4-2 / 6-4-2, W3 = 5-3-1 / 5-3-1. Same exercises throughout — load increases each wave and each week.

undulating._docs: Wave loading. Each week is one cycle of the repsPerSet array applied to the main strength block (the single non-paired block at top of each session). Sets 1-3 are wave 1; sets 4-6 are wave 2 (heavier).

strength-wave-4day.notes: Peaking block — 3 weeks of wave-loaded main lifts. Wave structure: 2 waves of 3 sets per session, reps DESCEND within a wave (e.g. 7-5-3), waves get HEAVIER each week (W1 7-5-3, W2 6-4-2, W3 5-3-1). The book aims for a true 1RM on the final set of W3 on squat, deadlift, and bench/shoulder press. Workout D's main is a 3 × 5-10 pull where the goal is rep PR (same weight as previous block, add reps). Day mapping: A hinge, B vertical push, C squat, D vertical pull. Mobility cycle: A+C hip+ankle, B+D t-spine+ankle. Only for athletes deep into a strength cycle who need a peaking week.
